title: Cumulative loans originated, 2025
prompt: Show the cumulative count of new loans originated by month for 2025 — a running total finance can chart.
metricDefinition: cumulative count of loans originated, by month, through 2025.
referenceSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', originated_at) AS month, count(*) AS new_loans FROM loans WHERE originated_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND originated_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', originated_at)) SELECT month, new_loans, sum(new_loans) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_loans FROM monthly ORDER BY month
